messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Added a **Deal name** field. Named saves export as version 2 and restore the name when loaded; unnamed version 1 saves still work. New Game, Restart, size changes, and board-code loads clear the name.

Also fixed pasted snapshots with reordered JSON keys: validation now checks the exact fields without requiring a particular key order.

**Checks:** Typecheck passed; unit tests passed (143); the named-combination browser suite passed (78), including the new save/load journey. The changed files pass Prettier. The full format check still flags 11 unchanged files.

Updated [the reproduction controls](/work/src/game/controls/Reproduction.tsx), [snapshot handling](/work/src/game/snapshot.ts), and the [acceptance guidance](/work/docs/acceptance.md).
